dogecoin.text: Elon Musk: $BOO feels like the lovechild of Dogecoin and TikTok. Maybe it's time for a decentralized meme-based AI overlord?
Barron Trump: $BOO is less a memecoin, more a movement. Like Dogecoin, but with ghosts of celebrities haunting your wallet. Can't wait for dad to launch one. 😐
**Elon Musk:** People asked if Tesla would launch its own memecoin. I said no, but now $BOO exists. It's like all celebrities collectively said, "Hold my Dogecoin."
